title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The improved resilience of chronically-affected populations programme in the Basse-Kotto Prefecture of the Central African Republic implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to improve the resilience of the extreme poor communities through enhanced access to high-quality nutrition, health, WASH services, and increased resistance to shocks. The objectives of the programme is to increase food security through increased access to diverse and productive yields; to improve access and management of clean water supplies; and to improve hygiene, health and nutritional practices within vulnerable communities. Communities will also have increased capacity to identify risks, respond and rebound from the impact of crises/shocks.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Extremely poor and vulnerable households are more productive, can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Awareness-raising activities on hygiene promotion and behavior change take place in the programme villages. Social behavious change committees will be established in Yr3. The committees will have representatives from across the community and aim to encourage women's awareness of water and sanitation and agricultural techniques to improve food security.
